scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c gray,white "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @codemap/web && npm run build --workspace @codemap/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @codemap/web && npm run lint --workspace @codemap/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @codemap/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @codemap/api
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate --workspace @codemap/api && npm run prisma:generate --workspace @codemap/web
